policies.title: Shipping Policy
policies.body:
## Processing
Orders are processed within 1 business day after payment is confirmed. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed the next business day.

## Delivery times
- Cairo & Giza: 1–3 business days
- Other governorates: 2–5 business days

Delivery times may vary during sales, holidays or unforeseen circumstances.

## Shipping fees
Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your governorate. Orders over 1000 EGP ship free.

## Tracking
Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation message with tracking details.

## Address accuracy
Please provide an accurate shipping address and phone number. Rivet.Co is not responsible for delays caused by incorrect details.

## Failed deliveries
Orders may be returned to us if the address is incorrect, delivery attempts repeatedly fail, or the customer is unavailable. Reshipping may incur additional charges.

## Questions
Contact Customer Support at info@rivetcoeg.com.

policies.title: Return & Refund Policy
policies.body:
## Returns
You have 14 days after receiving your item to request a return. To be eligible, the item must be:
- In the same condition you received it
- Unworn and unused, with tags attached
- In its original packaging
- Accompanied by your receipt or proof of purchase

To start a return, email info@rivetcoeg.com.

## Damaged, defective or wrong items
Please inspect your order on arrival and contact us immediately if anything is wrong so we can make it right.

## Non-returnable items
Sale items and gift cards cannot be returned.

## Exchanges
The fastest way to get what you want is to return the item you have and, once the return is accepted, place a separate order for the new item.

## Refunds
We'll notify you once we've received and inspected your return. Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 10 business days. Your bank or card issuer may take extra time to post it. If more than 15 business days have passed since approval, please contact us.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.body:
## What we collect
When you place an order we collect your name, phone number, email and delivery address so we can process and deliver it. When you contact us, we keep your message so we can reply.

## Payments
Card payments are handled by our payment provider, Paymob. Your card details are entered on their secure page and never stored on our website.

## How we use your information
We use your details only to fulfil orders, provide support and, if you agree, tell you about new products. We share them only with the providers needed to run the store, such as payment and delivery partners.

## Your choices
You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time by emailing info@rivetcoeg.com.

policies.title: Terms of Service
policies.body:
## Overview
By using this website and placing an order, you agree to these terms.

## Products and pricing
We do our best to show products, colours and prices accurately. Prices are in Egyptian pounds and may change without notice. If an item is listed at an incorrect price, we may cancel the order and refund you in full.

## Orders
An order is confirmed once payment is successful. We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock, in which case you'll receive a full refund.

## Shipping and returns
Shipping and returns are covered by our Shipping Policy and Return & Refund Policy.

## Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent to info@rivetcoeg.com.
